query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `template_usage_events` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `template_id` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `channel` varchar(20) NOT NULL,
  `agency_id` int NULL,
  `user_id` int NOT NULL,
  `client_id` int NULL,
  `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  CONSTRAINT `template_usage_events_agency_id_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`agency_id`) REFERENCES `agencies` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `template_usage_events_user_id_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `template_usage_events_client_id_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`client_id`) REFERENCES `clients` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL
);
